home.heroAlt: Ake Petcu — photography and visual work

portrait.label: Portrait
portrait.intro: One-to-one sessions, natural light or studio. Less about a pose and more about a few minutes of real attention — the kind of picture that still looks like you in ten years.

editorial.label: Editorial
editorial.intro: Shoots built around an idea: styling, location and light planned in advance and directed on the day, for magazines, brands and personal series.

actor-headshots.label: Actor Headshots
actor-headshots.intro: Sharp, current headshots that read well at thumbnail size. Quick, simple direction on the day, and a contact sheet back the same evening so you can pick fast.

projects.title: City of Glass
projects.description: A 14-minute short edited from roughly nine hours of footage, built around a single reveal saved for the final cut.

projects.title: Night Shift
projects.description: Observational documentary editing across a five-day shoot, structured into three acts without a scripted narration track.

projects.title: Low Tide
projects.description: Full grade for a music video shot on mixed cameras, matched to a single desaturated, warm-shadow look.

projects.title: Harbor Light
projects.description: Product commercial graded for a cleaner, higher-contrast daylight look while keeping skin tones neutral.

sound-design.label: Sound Design
sound-design.tagline: What you feel before you notice it.

projects.title: Static Hour
projects.description: Full sound design and mix built from location audio, foley and a sparse synth bed.

projects.title: Open Water
projects.description: Dialogue cleanup, ambient layering and final mix for a feature-length documentary.
